description: Catalogues of earthquakes in West Bohemia is a dataset listed in EGDI Metadata Catalogue, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by ig.cas.cz. Catalogues of earthquakes in West Bohema from stations of local seismic network WEBNET. Data are stored in annual files. Coverage: Europe. Its keywords include geofyzika, CzechGeo, geophysics, seismologie, seismology. The listing shows 1 download or service links in TXT. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geology-cz.
